comments.text: Can you please make a honest video about the Coleco Chameleon ? I found so many Youtubers hating the Coleco Chameleon project. Saying it was a scam. But as far as I could find the people behind it are legit gaming industry vets. And they admitted the whole time that the prototype was just a Frankenstein mess. It was never claimed to be a finished retail unit like the haters claim they did. To me it looks like haters got a legit retro projects crowdfunding shut down early. And cost Coleco fans a great idea. They same haters went on to Slander the Amico until they got its crowdfunding shut down to. Phil Adam was the target of hate both times. I trust you to take all the real info and separate it from the online hearsay. Thanks ! Its almost like slandering start up company's is a theme for entire genre of youtube creators.
